message: I’ve learned the hard way that when the weather gets wild, my phone might just decide to take a nap too. So, I keep my boots and raincoat by the back door, ready for whatever Mother Nature throws at us. It’s like my own little emergency drill, minus the sirens. What’s your go-to prep for stormy days?
scene: boots and a raincoat by the back door, puddles outside (overcast daylight)
